title: MCP Explained: How AI Apps Connect to Tools
headline:
How does an AI
connect to your tools?
meaning: MCP standardizes connections to tools and data.
example: An AI app can ask a connected service for information.
comparison: A connection protocol is different from permission.
caution: Review the server, data access and action permissions.
question: Which tool would you connect first?
lines: An A I model and your calendar are different systems. How does an app connect the two?
The Model Context Protocol, or M C P, standardizes how A I applications connect to tools and data sources.
A connected service can expose useful information or actions in a structured way the application understands.
Think of a common connection language. It does not magically give a model access to everything.
Permissions, server trust, and what data gets shared still need careful setup.
